out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed hand sink by the 3-compartment sink being used to store pots
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. PIC MOVED THE POTS OUT OF THE HAND SINK. HAND SINK IS FOR HAND WASHING ONLY.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: 1) in the walk-in cooler, Raw ground beef was observed being stored above cooked onions
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED THE RAW GROUND BEEF TO A LOWER SHELF. THIS VIOLATION WAS CORRECTED. THIS IS A REPEAT VIOLATION.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: 1) in the walk-in cooler: spiced tomato sauce (49f), lamb shank (46f)
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. PIC DISCARDED THE FOOD.

violations.corrective_action: Label all working containers of poisonous and toxic materials, including cleaners and sanitizers, with a common name to prevent the dangerous misuse of these materials. PIC LABELED THE SPRAY BOTTLE AS DEGREASER.

EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO WASH HIS HANDS AFTER HE TOUCHES HIS FACE. PIC WASHED HIS HANDS.

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Hand washing sink by the 3 compartment sink was observed blocked with food storage containers.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. ALL HAND SINKS MUST BE ACCESSIBLE TO FACILITATE PROPER HAND WASHING. PLEASE CORRECT THIS BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: Raw shelled egg were observed being stored on top of cooked ground beef.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. PIC MOVED RAW SHELLED EGGS TO THE BOTTOM SHELF OF THE COOLER.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: Observed portioned dumplings without date marking. Upon discussion with PIC, dumplings were made more than 24 hours ago.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO DATE MARK FOOD THAT IS STORED MORE THAN 24 HOURS. SELL OR DISCARD WITHIN 7 DAYS OF DATE.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 1) 4DWR prep top cooler
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. PLACE AN AMBIENT AIR THERMOMETER IN THIS COOLER.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: Observed water and oil being stored in unlabeled spray bottles.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PLEASE LABEL ALL SPRAY BOTTLES WITH ITS CONTENTS. CORRECT BY THE FOLLOW UP INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Observed PIC coffee cup being stored in the ice machine.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. PIC REMOVED THE COFFEE CUP. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO NOT PUT BEVERAGES IN THE ICE MACHINE.

violations.title: Miscellaneous Source Contamination
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were found subject to contamination after receipt and during storage due to the condition as described: observed a box of potatoes being stored outside and uncovered on a shelf
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination that may result from a factor or source not specified under Subparts 3-301 through 3-306. PIC DISCARDED THE POTATOES.

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed food being stored on the floor of the walk-in refrigerator
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PLEASE ELEVATE ALL FOOD OFF OF THE FLOOR TO FACILITATE PROPER CLEANING.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: observed a knife and utensil being stored in a container of water.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. PIC MOVED THE UTENSILS TO THE DISH WASHING AREA TO BE CLEANED AND SANITIZED.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items No Reuse
violations.observation: Bulk garlic and bulk peppercorn manufacturer containers were observed reused for the storage of turmeric, cardamom, and other dried spices.
violations.corrective_action: Manufacturer containers may not be reused for secondary storage of other foods because the containers are not durable enough for multiple reuse and become uncleanable. STORE BULK SPICES IN NSF APPROVED STORAGE CONTAINERS. DISCARD ALL OLD, WORN SPICE CONTAINERS.

violations.corrective_action: Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other foods that require frequent cleaning shall be constructed of a corrosion- resistant, nonabsorbent, and smooth material. violations.corrective_action: The food-contact surfaces of cooking equipment and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. MORE FREQUENT AND ROUTINE CLEANING IS REQUIRED.

out_items.name: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control

violations.title: Methods to Facilitate Cooling in Equipment
violations.observation: Upon discussion with PIC, lamb shanks and cooked eggplants were cooked the day prior. While warm, PIC covered the cooked food and placed them in a cooler. The lamb shanks were cooked in a a large pot, covered and placed in the walk-in. The eggplants were cooked in a deep hotel pan, covered and placed in the 4DWR under counter cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Cooling hot foods shall be accomplished as follows: 1) placing the food in shallow pans; 2) separating the food into smaller or thinner portions; 3) using rapid cooling equipment; 4) stirring the food in a container placed in an ice water bath; 5) using containers that facilitate heat transfer; 6) adding ice as an ingredient; or other effective methods. Food containers placed in cooling and cold equipment to cool shall be: 1) arranged in the equipment to provide maximum heat transfer through the containers walls, and 2) loosely covered or uncovered as long as protected from contamination to facilitate heat transfer from the surface of the food. EHS INSTRUCTED PIC TO LEAVE THE FOOD UNCOVERED TO FACILITATE PROPER COOLING.

violations.corrective_action: Nonfood-contact surfaces of equipment and utensils shall be cleaned at a frequency necessary to preclude accumulation of soil residues. MORE FREQUENT AND THOROUGH CLEANING OF THE EQUIPMENT IS REQUIRED.
